SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Bishop
A bishop, which moves any number of squares diagonally.
Board
The 8 × 8 chess board, stored as a grid of pieces, plus a record of every piece that has been captured.
ChessApp
The entry point for console chess.
Command
The things a player can type at the move prompt besides a move.
ConsoleUI
The text interface: shows the board, reads moves from the keyboard, and prints the result of each move.
Game
Runs a game of chess: holds the board and both players, tracks whose turn it is, and checks every move against the rules before carrying it out.
InputParser
Turns what the player types into a command or a move.
King
A king, which moves exactly one square in any direction.
Knight
A knight, which moves in an L shape: two squares in one direction and one square to the side.
MoveResult
The outcome of trying a move: whether it worked, and a message explaining what happened or why it was rejected.
Pawn
A pawn, the only piece whose movement depends on its color.
Piece
The superclass for all six chess pieces.
PieceColor
The two players in a chess game.
Player
One of the two people playing, identified by a name and the color they play.
Position
A square on the chess board, stored as an array row and column.
Queen
A queen, which moves any number of squares in a straight line or diagonally, combining the rook's and bishop's movement.
Rook
A rook, which moves any number of squares horizontally or vertically.
